actions.reason: K4_C0004 lacks positive evidence that its current membership is an independently represented unit. Its set-level native-geometry alignment is essentially absent (silhouettes CT -0.051, WSI -0.014, RNA 0.0003, WXS 0.044; within-set distances equal to or larger than between-set distances in every modality), and its pair boundaries against K4_C0001, K4_C0002, and K4_C0003 are likewise weakly expressed (near-zero/negative silhouettes in CT, RNA, and WSI, with only WXS showing separation). The set-scope confounder analysis found no corrected-significant association with measured technical/acquisition/site factors, but that only means no strong candidate-specific technical alternative was detected; it does not positively establish an independent boundary, and residual confounding cannot be excluded. The candidate does have an interpretable mutation-level identity (VHL-enriched, PBRM1-depleted) and a less coherent RNA phenotype, but biological interpretability does not substitute for membership-independence evidence. No split is warranted (partition-level screening shows no dominant internal subdivision), and no merge is justified: the pair structural reports show single-cluster-dominated unions with essentially zero boundary silhouettes, which is compatible with one-unit representation but is not sufficient by itself to justify merging, and the mutation/RNA phenotypes of the neighbors are not clearly compatible with a single coherent unit. With decision-relevant membership evidence exhausted and independence unsupported, K4_C0004 is not retained.

K4_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (broad down-regulation of OXPHOS and immune/inflammatory programs; PBRM1/VHL-enriched with BAP1 depletion), but its current membership is not positively supported as an independent unit. Set-level native-geometry alignment is weak (silhouettes 0.003-0.090, with WSI within-set distance slightly above between-set), and its boundaries against the nearest neighbors are weakly expressed: the K4_C0001|K4_C0002 pair shows small positive silhouettes in CT/RNA/WSI (0.043-0.056) with a fused boundary silhouette of essentially zero (0.0004), and the K4_C0001|K4_C0004 pair shows near-zero/negative silhouettes in CT/RNA/WSI with a fused boundary silhouette of essentially zero (0.00053). The pair structural reports show single-cluster-dominated unions, which is compatible with one-unit representation but is not sufficient by itself to justify a merge, and the distinct OXPHOS/immune and mutation directions relative to K4_C0002 and K4_C0004 weigh against collapsing them into one coherent unit. No split is warranted (no dominant internal subdivision signal). With membership-independence evidence weak and no justified structural revision, K4_C0001 is not retained.

K4_C0002 has an interpretable biological identity (up-regulated OXPHOS/metabolic/secretory programs; VHL/PBRM1-depleted mutation pattern), but its current membership is not positively supported as an independent unit. Set-level native-geometry alignment is weak (silhouettes 0.011-0.177, smallest in RNA), and its boundaries against the nearest neighbors are weakly expressed: the K4_C0001|K4_C0002 pair shows small positive silhouettes in CT/RNA/WSI (0.043-0.056) with a fused boundary silhouette of essentially zero (0.0004); the K4_C0002|K4_C0003 pair shows small positive silhouettes (0.052-0.143) with a fused boundary silhouette of essentially zero (0.00057); and the K4_C0002|K4_C0004 pair shows near-zero/negative silhouettes in CT/RNA/WSI with a fused boundary silhouette of essentially zero (0.00060). The pair structural reports show single-cluster-dominated unions, which is compatible with one-unit representation but is not sufficient by itself to justify a merge, and the distinct OXPHOS and mutation directions relative to K4_C0001 and K4_C0004 weigh against collapsing them into one coherent unit. No split is warranted (no dominant internal subdivision signal). With membership-independence evidence weak and no justified structural revision, K4_C0002 is not retained.

K4_C0003 has an interpretable biological identity (up-regulated immune/inflammatory programs; BAP1-enriched mutation pattern), but its current membership is not positively supported as an independent unit. Set-level native-geometry alignment is weak (silhouettes 0.035-0.098), and its boundaries against the nearest neighbors are weakly expressed: the K4_C0002|K4_C0003 pair shows small positive silhouettes (0.052-0.143) with a fused boundary silhouette of essentially zero (0.00057), and the K4_C0003|K4_C0004 pair shows small positive silhouettes (0.059-0.266) with a fused boundary silhouette of essentially zero (0.00085). The pair structural reports show single-cluster-dominated unions, which is compatible with one-unit representation but is not sufficient by itself to justify a merge, and the distinct immune and mutation directions relative to K4_C0002 and K4_C0004 weigh against collapsing them into one coherent unit. No split is warranted (no dominant internal subdivision signal). With membership-independence evidence weak and no justified structural revision, K4_C0003 is not retained.
